summary: Regression check after resilience fixes (optional motor import, guarded Mongo init, non-fatal OSC bind). Re-ran full pytest suite against the live supervisor backend at localhost:8001. All 5/5 tests passed in 7.67s: /api/status shape, idle state, OSC sender pipeline (opening_titles.mov ch1 45s / commercial_break.mp4 ch2 20s, time_left math), LIVE status when total=0, and WebSocket /api/ws streaming (immediate frame + continuous frames). Supervisor logs show clean startup: 'OSC UDP listener started on 0.0.0.0:7250' + 'WebSocket broadcast loop started'. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown; migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler when convenient.
Mongo client is created at import even though DB is unused; consider deferring or removing until a settings page exists.
WebSocket endpoint has no ping/keepalive; long-running kiosk clients behind proxies could see stale sockets.
seed_data_creation: None. OSC traffic simulated via /app/backend/test_osc_sender.py inside pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resilience regression check is green. motor optional-import, guarded Mongo init, and try/except around OSC bind confirmed to not break live behavior. Suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; pytest.ini uses xdist LoadScopeScheduling so OSC-sensitive tests share a worker (avoids UDP 7250 collisions).
